purpose: Assess whether each core property-title proposition is sufficiently verified for public publication.

propositions.reason: Final proposition-specific amendment/commencement and case-law audit remains.
Possessory-title case-law and historical procedure require final audit.

blocking_rules: A proposition cannot be published merely because its statute is identified.
Material unresolved amendment/commencement effects block publication.
Material unresolved case-law questions block publication where judicial interpretation is necessary.
An official procedure can be published only with its current rule/history context.
No proposition establishes facts about a particular property without property-specific evidence.
next_step: Complete final proposition-specific audit rather than upgrading status from partial evidence.
